info.title: AI-SRO
info.summary: Workflow Builder: demonstrations in, reviewable skills out.

get.description: Liveness: the process answers. Deliberately touches no dependency.

schema.title: Response List Connections V1 Connections Get

post.description: Open a browser at the system. The operator signs in there, not here.

Keep the session the operator just created.

Called when they say they are signed in. The cookies are read out of the
browser and encrypted into the vault; nothing about them is returned here.

Headers the executor must send as this session and cannot derive.

The response names the keys and never the values: an endpoint that echoed a
credential back would put it in every proxy log between here and the caller.

get.description: Null when the demonstration is over or the provider has reaped it.
Playback links, minted per request and short-lived.

schema.title: Response Get Media V1 Recordings  Recording Id  Media Get

post.description:
``recorded_from`` is when the microphone started, for audio.

Without it a transcript's offsets cannot be placed against the frames, and
narration attaches to the wrong steps -- which is worse than none.

Two runs to one skill version.

Runs through Temporal rather than in the request: a failed induction keeps a
history worth reading, and a retry starts from the sealed recordings rather
than from a browser session nobody can reproduce. The caller still waits --
induction takes milliseconds -- but the work is not lost if this process is.

schema.title: Response List Skills V1 Skills Get

post.description:
Perform the skill at L1.

What the stage means here: `shadow` sends every read and withholds every
write, producing the exact request it would have sent. Above shadow the
writes go out, and the request must name the human who authorised that.
